description: This Java class is a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used in the email labeling feature. It encapsulates a list of label IDs to be assigned to an email, with validation annotations and Swagger schema documentation annotations.

classes.name: AssignLabelsRequest
classes.description: A DTO for requesting assignment of labels to an email, containing a list of label IDs.

methods.name: AssignLabelsRequest(List<Long> labelIds)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the label IDs with the provided list.

methods.name: getLabelIds()
methods.description: Getter for the list of label IDs.

methods.name: setLabelIds(List<Long> labelIds)
methods.description: Setter for the list of label IDs.
